title: A criterion for weighted uniform distribution along functions from a Hardy field
summary: A classical theorem of Boshernitzan states that if $f$ is a function which belongs to a Hardy field and which satisfies $|f(x)|\prec x^{\ell}$ for some $\ell\in \mathbb{N}$, then the sequence $(f(n))_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ is uniformly distributed modulo 1 if and only if $\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{|f(x)-p(x)|}{\log(x)} = \infty$ for all $p(x)\in \mathbb{Q}[x]$. We provide a new proof of this result using methods from summability theory and we extend Boshernitzan's criterion by obtaining necessary and sufficient conditions for $f$ to be uniformly distributed modulo 1 with respect to a broad class of…
